summary: BigBear.ai Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to 100,000,000 common shares through Jefferies. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), with no fixed price, premium, or special-situation event. Jefferies acts as sales agent with up to 3.0% commission. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural special features are involved. The last sale price was $2.83 per share on July 30, 2026. This is an ordinary capital-raising document, not a special situation, so no risk-arb angle applies.
